title: 층간소음
scene: 밤 11시, 윗집에서 쿵쿵 소리. 도윤이 「천장 치지 마」라고 말린다. 다음 날 윗집 아주머니가 떡을 들고 온다
goal: Neighbor noise — and the apartment etiquette around it

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: They're stomping again, it's already eleven

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Floor noise, what can you do, bear with it
turns.note: 층간소음 = noise between floors · 참다 = to endure

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Should I go up and say something?

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 밤에 직접 가면 싸움 나 경비실에 말해
turns.rd: bame jikjeop gamyeon ssaum na gyeongbisire malhae
turns.en: If you go yourself at night it turns into a fight, tell security

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 뉴스에 맨날 나와 그니까 천장 치지 마
turns.rd: nyuseue maennal nawa geunikka cheonjang chiji ma
turns.en: It's on the news all the time, so don't bang the ceiling
turns.note: 천장 치다 = bang the ceiling (classic retaliation)

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Oh really? Fine we'll see tomorrow

turns.speaker: C
turns.en: Hello we're from upstairs, it was loud yesterday right?

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 아… 네 조금요 죄송합니다 제가 천장을…
turns.rd: a… ne jogeumyo joesonghamnida jega cheonjangeul…
turns.en: Oh… yes a little, I'm sorry I hit the ceiling…

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: 아니에요 우리 애가 뛰어서요 이거 떡이에요 드세요
turns.rd: anieyo uri aega ttwieoseoyo igeo tteogieyo deuseyo
turns.en: No our kid was running, here rice cakes please have some

turns.speaker: A
turns.note: 떡 = rice cake — the neighbor gift

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: 이사 오셨는데 인사도 못 드렸네요 애가 다시 뛰면 바로 말씀하세요
turns.rd: isa osyeonneunde insado mot deuryeonneyo aega dasi ttwimyeon baro malsseumhaseyo
turns.en: You moved in and we never said hello, if the kid runs again tell us right away

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 감사합니다… 저 어제 천장 친 거 정말 죄송해요
turns.rd: gamsahamnida… jeo eoje cheonjang chin geo jeongmal joesonghaeyo
turns.en: Thank you… and I'm really sorry about hitting the ceiling

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: See? That's the Korean solution, with rice cakes

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: …I should bring rice cakes tomorrow too
